integrity: General theorem proved by structural multiplier and eigenvalue-pairing arguments; finite matrix and group enumeration independently check selected rank-one cases, not all ranks.
scientific_limitations: Exact automorphism counts concern odd prime orders, not arbitrary finite cyclic complements. The class count is conjugacy in the group automorphism group and does not classify unmarked semidirect products. Historical priority may depend on earlier specialization of classical symplectic similitude conjugacy theory.
title: Prime-order Frobenius actions on extraspecial groups: exact counts and conjugacy types
